key_insight: An H₂-optimal design framework systematically identifies riblet profiles that suppress velocity fluctuations at a fixed spanwise spacing.
engineering_relevance: The approach could guide turbulence-control surface design beyond exhaustive searches over predefined riblet shapes.
method: Model riblets through volume penalization in the linearized Navier–Stokes equations.
Recast penalization as structured state feedback.
Optimize fluctuation variance and riblet-induced dynamical augmentations while maintaining constant bulk flux.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports optimal wall-normal profiles for fixed riblet spacing but provides no quantitative attenuation results or experimental validation.
watch_item: Optimality is model-based and spacing-specific; performance in nonlinear turbulent flow and resulting drag reduction require validation.
paper_title: $H_2$-optimal riblet profiles for turbulence suppression in channel flows
